observations: Configuration-only evidence has fitted/assumed inputs, expandable citations and no saved output.
Actual full A0 run displays current evidence and requirement-not-configured without acceptance.
Selected P17 evidence and source details render without document overflow at1440,1920,1024,390px.
Delayed genuine evidence responses cannot overwrite a later component selection.
Keyboard layout changes update component evidence while preserving the physics revision and current run.
Preview preserves every project byte; changing and reverting the input still requires a new preview.
An external revision invalidates preview; manual Apply rechecks and leaves the project unchanged.
Explicit manual Apply creates the declared A1 revision, preserves historical ownership and never starts a simulation.
Failed partial simulation retains its exact stop reason, partial status and evidence limitations.
Untrusted provenance is escaped as text in previews; no injected markup or script executes.
scope: Software integration only; synthetic fault/setup edits; no new experimental outcomes
